notes: A FULL VISUAL AND BRANDING REVIEW, ACTED ON. Three independent reviewers went over MoRaj Ledger's design, its screens and — most importantly — the documents it prints. Everything they found is fixed in this release. YOUR DOCUMENTS CARRY YOUR OWN NAME, GUARANTEED. Sixteen printed letterheads — payment vouchers, payslips, the GRA withholding certificates your payees file, the VAT return, Excel exports — read your organisation's name directly from the record. If you had not yet entered your business name, those documents could go out headed by the software's internal name. Vouchers print while still in DRAFT, before the go-live check that catches this, so the door was guarded but not shut. It is shut now, and an automatic test refuses any future document that skips the check. Nothing your auditor, banker or GRA officer sees will carry anything but your own letterhead. EASIER ON THE EYES. Column headings, hints and placeholders were below the accepted contrast standard — the smallest text in the app and the text you stare at for hours. Darker now. The primary button also failed contrast in dark mode; corrected. CLEARER, FASTER SCREENS. Delete is red and no longer looks identical to Post. Money column headings sit over their figures. One date format everywhere — 04 Aug 2026 — the same on every computer, replacing three different formats. Required fields are marked before you press Save. Financial statements show negatives in accounting parentheses, as a statement should. Your General Ledger, journal list and cheque register fit more rows on screen. Settings now has an index at the top: 24 sections, one click each, instead of scrolling. Empty screens explain what they are for instead of saying nothing is there. Filed documents carry the date they were printed. And the MoRaj Ledger mark now stays legible at small sizes, in the menu bar and on the taskbar. NAMING. The vendor is MoRaj Supplies and Consult — corrected everywhere, including inside the installed program. The trial no longer introduces itself under an internal build name, and no screen shows developer instructions. There is NO database change in this release: your data and settings are untouched, and upgrading is simply installing over the old version.
